summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, announcing the appointment of Mr. Ichijo Futakawa as a non-executive director, effective the same day. The appointment follows a recommendation from the Board's Nomination Committee. Mr. Futakawa, aged 50, is division general manager of corporate strategy at Nissan Motor Co., Ltd. This is a routine board appointment with no sudden or forced departure. The filing includes no terms regarding price, premium, or deal mechanics. Since it is a routine management addition rather than an abrupt change, classification as Management Changes is low confidence.
